name: Tribe Mentality [Selfish, Teamwork]
body:
You and your tribemates grant each other mental strength.

Benefit(s): When you’re simultaneously subject to the same enchantment (compulsion) or [emotion] effect as another ally, you both roll saves but you can use either result.
